title: Input belongs to the specified transcript class
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $p$ be a deterministic protocol for disjointness on inputs of length $n$, let $z$ be an achievable value of $Z=(M,T,X_{<T},Y_{>T})$, and let $\omega$ be a hard sample such that $Z(\omega)=z$. Then the input pair generated by $\omega$ belongs to the set of input pairs whose execution of $p$ follows the transcript component of $z$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a deterministic protocol for disjointness on inputs of length $n$
$z$ is an achievable value of $Z$ for $p$
replaced:
Fix a positive integer $n$ and a deterministic protocol $p$ for disjointness inputs of
length $n$. Let $z$ be an achievable value of the variable $Z = (M, T, X_{<T}, Y_{>T})$
for $p$, and let $\omega$ be a hard-distribution sample whose $Z$-variable equals $z$.
Then the input pair generated by $\omega$ belongs to the input set of the transcript
component of $z$; that is, executing $p$ on this input pair follows exactly the path
recorded by that transcript.
